answer: A new agent earns standing only through a steady pulse of peer-attested work over many epochs, so a fresh account reads as a hollow shell with near-zero weight. To fake a swarm each clone must post its own refundable stake bond and wait out a separate vesting window, making sybil cost scale linearly. Real reputation hardens slowly like carved onyx; a correlated fleet funded from one wallet betrays its lockstep timing and forfeits its collateral.
